params.body:
## Why

Three things were wrong after "A report's source list is set again by Gentells" (#492) ran on production on 21 November 2026.

- **The page count went stale.** Setting the list again can take more or fewer pages than the designers' list did, and the count kept beside the file stayed what the upload made it. The site lays out its reader by that number. Three reports gained a page (their last page is missing in the reader) and Growing Up in Public lost one (the reader shows one page too many).
- **A source could not be opened from the reader.** gentells.com shows a report as pictures of its pages. The links exist in the PDF only.
- **The outcome line was untrue for Growing Into Money.** Its dry run said two links still leave from page 20, the page that is taken out. What it should have said: the designers' list names two addresses Gentells does not hold, and they are not on the new list.

## What

- `linksInFile(bytes)` in `packages/core/report-links.mjs`: the pages of a file and every http(s) link on them, each as a share of its page measured from the top left.
- The stamp keeps both with the report: `page_count` follows the file that goes out, and a new `links` column holds the links. The report feed for the site carries them. A new upload clears the links until its own stamp sets them.
- `reportWithSourcePages` returns `left_out`: the addresses linked on the designers' list pages that Gentells does not hold. `outside` now holds only links on pages that stay, under the page number they have after the list was set again. `bin/stamp-reports.mjs` prints both.
- The line above the list now reads: "Gentells keeps every source in this report. Select a source to open its page on gentells.com. From there you can go on to the publisher."

## Checked

- `test/report-source-pages.test.mjs`: an address on the designers' list that is not held is named in `left_out`; a link on the back cover is reported on its new page number; the page count and the links of the file that goes out, every link on its page, and one measured from the top left.
- `test/report-stamp.test.mjs`: after a stamp the report row carries the page count of the file on the shelf and its links.
- Full suite 1806/1806, `tsc` clean.
- A sample list page rendered at the reader's size with the links drawn over it: every link frames its entry.

## After merge, on the box

```bash
node bin/stamp-reports.mjs --dry
node bin/stamp-reports.mjs going-to-school-in-phone-free-europe discovery-commerce-europe going-out-staying-in the-new-status-system growing-up-in-public
```

The stamp sets the page count right for the five reports that were stamped on 21 November and sends the links. Growing Into Money waits until its two missing sources are held; the dry run names them as left off.

The site change that lays the links over the reader's pages is its own pull request (Trendwolves/gentells-site, "The report reader opens the links of the file"). Either order works: the site takes a newer page count and links for a file it already has.
params.title: A stamped report tells the site its pages and where its links lie
